5860.title: Footer overflow clipped by the sidebar body
5860.rootCauseOneLine: The separate footer collapsible body clips at its own top edge, excluding upward inline cards from painting and pointer hit-testing.
5860.proposedFix: Separate expanded footer overlays from the clipped visual surface while preserving framed corners and rail-collapse concealment, with browser hit-test coverage for every variant.
5860.caveats: Synthetic fixture using real production sidebar primitives, not a third-party plugin installation or native macOS test. No production PR: a variant-safe repair requires browser regression coverage or an overlay-contract decision outside the simple-fix scope.
